identity.name: Royal Oak Jumbo Extra-Thin
identity.one_liner: The 50th-anniversary Jumbo: the 1972 case dimensions kept, the 50-year-old caliber 2121 finally replaced.

comps.condition: similar reference: Audemars Piguet 16202BC.OO.1240BC.02 · Royal Oak “Jumbo” Extra-Thin

provenance_events.description: Audemars Piguet releases the 16202ST as the modern-day descendant of the 15202ST. The new caliber 7121 with a full rotor replaces the Frédéric Piguet-derived 2121, marking the first new movement architecture in the "Jumbo" line in fifty years.

Audemars Piguet releases the 16202ST as the modern-day descendant of the 15202ST Jumbo Extra-Thin. The new calibre 7121 (full rotor) replaces the Frédéric Piguet-derived 2121, marking the first new movement architecture in the "Jumbo" line in fifty years. Hong Kong collector demand drives the secondary market at MSRP-plus.

narrative.story: Launched in 2022 for the Royal Oak's 50th anniversary, the 16202ST succeeded the 15202 with the case unchanged at 39mm x 8.1mm and the movement completely new: caliber 7121, larger, with 55 hours of reserve and a quick-set date the 2121 never had. First-year examples carry a '50 years' anniversary rotor. The blue petite tapisserie dial continues the Jumbo lineage unbroken.
narrative.collector_notes: The anniversary rotor marks 2022 production and collectors already sort by it. Waitlists at AP boutiques remain the norm for steel; the smoked-dial and precious-metal variants trade very differently from the standard blue.
